episodes.title: Part 1: The Solo Honeymoon
episodes.break_rationale: Crushed by Vijay calling off their wedding at the Delhi cafe, a devastated Rani makes the courageous decision to embark on their pre-booked Paris honeymoon completely alone, stepping out into the bustling European night.
episodes.recap_text: In Rajouri Garden, Delhi, conservative bride Rani's world shatters when fiancé Vijay calls off their wedding one day before the ceremony. Defying family expectations, Rani packs her bags for Paris alone.
episodes.teaser_next: Stranded in Paris with no international travel experience, Rani faces culture shock, lost directions, and a chaotic street confrontation.

episodes.title: Part 2: Parisian Freedom
episodes.break_rationale: After an exhilarating, liberating night across Paris with free-spirited Vijaylaxmi, Rani boards the train to Amsterdam transformed, only to discover her new budget hostel room is shared with three unfamiliar foreign men.
episodes.recap_text: In Paris, vibrant Indo-French hotel worker Vijaylaxmi takes Rani under her wing, helping her overcome heartbreak and taste independence for the first time.
episodes.teaser_next: Rani arrives in free-spirited Amsterdam and must navigate sharing a tiny hostel room with three boisterous male roommates.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Amsterdam Awakening
episodes.break_rationale: Rani triumphs at the Amsterdam street festival cooking Delhi golgappas and winning the crowd, but as she celebrates with her roommates, a guilt-ridden Vijay unexpectedly arrives in Amsterdam begging for her forgiveness.
episodes.recap_text: Overcoming initial awkwardness, Rani forms an unbreakable bond with hostel roommates Taka, Tim, and Oleksandr, discovering her entrepreneurial passion making street snacks.
episodes.teaser_next: Vijay corners Rani in Amsterdam, demanding she return to domestic life just as Rani discovers the power of her own independence.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Triumphant Return
episodes.break_rationale: Rani lovingly bids farewell to her European companions, returns to Delhi, and visits Vijay only to calmly return his engagement ring with a radiant, liberating smile of absolute self-worth.
episodes.recap_text: Rejecting Vijay's regressive demands, Rani chooses herself, turning heartbreak into a triumphant celebration of womanhood and self-realization.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the beloved coming-of-age comedy-drama miniseries cut of Queen.
